name: OBSBOT Control
author: nofuturekid
description: Control the OBSBOT Tiny 2 Lite webcam through obsbot4linux from a bar widget, a Control Center tile and a desktop preview widget: sleep/wake, AI tracking, zoom, pan/tilt, field of view, HDR, exposure, image, audio, gestures and a live preview. Requires obsbot4linux >= 0.7.1.
